title: Prompt-Replacement Relief on Home Comfort Financing Returned-Payment Fees
content:
A Home Comfort Financing borrower who replaces a returned payment promptly earns a prompt-replacement relief on the returned-payment fee. The prompt-replacement relief is 30 percent when the most recent payment posted on the day the most recent returned payment came back or no more than 3 days after it, 15 percent when it posted more than 3 but no more than 10 days after it, and zero when no payment has posted since the return or it posted later.

The two dates are read from the account: the date of the most recent returned-payment entry, and the posting date of the most recent payment entry. The gap is counted in calendar days from the first to the second.

| Most recent payment posted … | Prompt-replacement relief |
|---|---|
| on the day of the most recent return, or 1 to 3 days after it | 30 percent |
| 4 to 10 days after it | 15 percent |
| 11 or more days after it | zero |
| no payment since the return (the most recent payment is dated before the return) | zero |

The relief is one of the returned-payment reliefs. The returned-payment reliefs are added together into the returned-payment relief percentage, and the scheduled returned-payment fee is reduced once by that total; the reliefs never act one after another.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, return dated 6 May)

| Most recent payment dated | Days after the return | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| 6 May | 0 | 30 percent |
| 9 May | 3 | 30 percent |
| 10 May | 4 | 15 percent |
| 16 May | 10 | 15 percent |
| 17 May | 11 | zero |
| 28 April (before the return) | — | zero |
